name: seedance-production-master
description: Director-execution and prompt-production workflow for turning scripts, visual scripts, storyboards, and generated-video feedback into stable Seedance 2.0/2.5 production prompts.

interface.longDescription: 把小说、剧本、可视化剧本或既有Seedance提示词转成可独立复制的生成组，并进行资产、空间、动作、摄影、表演、VFX、连续性和生成结果返修。
